summary: Trial 'catches' criterion (decision 6) is measured before the extraction net (decision 20) exists -- net ships at build step 6, after the v1 trial, so the trial's own catching mechanism isn't built yet when it's judged

Decisions rail at ~98 projects is an admitted open question (onepager top open call #2), and decision 19 cut the one filter (focus) that would have scoped it -- combined with 'everything on pick' (decision 14) this raises mis-click risk under rail-skimming

ARCH-1: in-process Mycroft DecisionQueue (internal/mycroft/escalate/escalate.go) still unreconciled with new bead-based decision design — same P0 the 2026-09-22 review already flagged, carried forward unresolved

ARCH-2/3: autarch-mcp is stdio JSON-RPC (pkg/mcp/server.go), not HTTP like bigend/gurgeh/signals — decision 10's 'consolidate into one autarch serve' skips the transport bridge this needs, and via decision 15's RPC-panel rule this may make build step 1 secretly depend on the full consolidation

SF1/SF2: no stated privilege separation between continuation-command execution and Home's ed25519 signing key (decision 18), and allowed_signers is committed inside Uqbar with no stated write-access restriction -- both mean 'only mk moves a fact to ruled' (Ultan ruling 2) is not yet structurally guaranteed
